carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Longitudinal ridges extending along the dorsal-lateral surface towards the caudal region, defined by a high-intensity luminance crest with immediate vertical gradient drop into shadow.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Elongated dark pixel cluster attached to the right lateral side of the caudal peduncle; slight structural irregularity on the posterior margin of the upper caudal lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Terminal tips of both the superior and inferior caudal lobes exhibit high-luminance white pixel clusters.
